item.title: Special Protection Areas (SPA) source files
item.subtitle: Designated & Protected Sites / DAERA, Northern Ireland Environment Agency
item.description: Designated under the EU Birds Directive for vulnerable, migratory and other significant bird species. 16 SPAs in NI form part of the Natura 2000 network. Many overlap with Ramsar / SAC / ASSI designations.
